dominant_breach: the federal student-loan portfolio is a public credit program whose costs can be shifted among borrowers, taxpayers, schools, servicers, and future cohorts unless portfolio status, repayment design, collection, and relief incidence are scored together
fastest_washout: aggregate portfolio balances and subsidy estimates obscure which borrowers face delinquency, default, offsets, negative amortization, credential risk, or delayed household formation

public_balance_sheet_gate.note: Federal student loans are a direct public-credit and household-claim-security surface; aggregate subsidy accounting cannot substitute for borrower-status and collection-incidence scoring.

student_loan_public_balance_sheet_exposu.note: Treasury credit notes and FSA portfolio data make student-loan exposure concrete at the balance, borrower, repayment, delinquency, deferment, and debt-size levels.

federal_credit_program_subsidy_transpare.note: Subsidy estimates differ under federal credit accounting methods; the case must preserve method sensitivity instead of certifying a single benign cost figure.

loan_guarantee_loss_visibility.note: Loss visibility requires borrower status, repayment plan, delinquency/default, collection, and forgiveness path, not just aggregate loan receivables.

debt_service_distributional_incidence.note: Borrower burden must be scored by income, race, gender, age, credential, family formation, and collection exposure, especially when repayment/relief rules are volatile.

proof_debt: portfolio balance, borrower count, repayment status, delinquency/default, deferment/forbearance, IDR, age, debt-size, and program/credential incidence
FCRA versus fair-value subsidy difference by loan type, repayment plan, forgiveness path, and collection regime
Treasury offset, wage garnishment, tax-refund seizure, credit reporting, and hardship-protection incidence
school/program accountability and whether public credit risk subsidizes low-value credentials or private tuition extraction
interaction with bankruptcy/fresh-start, family formation, homeownership, medical debt, and intergenerational transfers

gate_20_public_balance_sheet.why: Comfort certification is blocked until the student-loan portfolio is scored by borrower status, credit-program accounting method, collection hardship, school accountability, and public-upside/fresh-start design.

evidence_debt_register.question: borrower-status incidence across repayment/delinquency/default/IDR/deferment/debt-size
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Bind FSA Data Center quarterly portfolio tables to status, age, debt-size, repayment-plan, delinquency, and collection-hardship rows.

evidence_debt_register.question: FCRA versus fair-value subsidy and forgiveness cost method
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Maintain both federal credit-program accounting views and identify which policy conclusions are method-sensitive.

evidence_debt_register.question: collection and hardship protection
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Map wage garnishment, tax refund offset, Social Security offset, credit reporting, servicer error, and hardship-exemption incidence.

evidence_debt_register.question: school/program accountability and public upside
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Trace whether schools/programs that captured tuition financed by public credit share losses or face recapture/eligibility consequences.

20A_debt_interest_capacity.question: Do debt service and maturity/interest risks crowd out floors, services, enforcement, public investment, or countercyclical repair?
20A_debt_interest_capacity.finding: This subgate is not a material live channel in this case.

20B_claim_security.question: Are social-insurance, pension, health, disability, care, or public-benefit promises financed and legally durable enough to count as wealth substitutes?
20B_claim_security.finding: Repayment and forgiveness terms are public claims that borrowers plan around.

20C_contingent_liabilities_guarantees.question: Are guarantees, insurance funds, credit programs, SOEs, PPPs, disaster obligations, and legal claims disclosed and stress-tested?
20C_contingent_liabilities_guarantees.finding: Federal credit exposure requires transparent subsidy and loss accounting.

20D_crisis_backstop_governance.question: Who is rescued under stress, under what terms, with what haircut, condition, sunset, and report?
20D_crisis_backstop_governance.finding: This subgate is not a material live channel in this case.

20E_public_upside_recovery.question: Does the public receive warrants, equity, fees, clawbacks, senior claims, recoveries, or other upside when it absorbs downside?
20E_public_upside_recovery.finding: This subgate is not a material live channel in this case.

20F_central_bank_quasi_fiscal_visibility.question: Are remittance losses, deferred assets, interest-on-reserves distribution, facilities, and asset-price stabilization effects visible?
20F_central_bank_quasi_fiscal_visibility.finding: This subgate is not a material live channel in this case.

20G_public_asset_sovereign_wealth_govern.question: Are public assets rule-bound, professionally managed, protected from raiding, and linked to ordinary claimants?
20G_public_asset_sovereign_wealth_govern.finding: This subgate is not a material live channel in this case.

20H_generational_intergovernmental_incid.question: Does repair fall on younger cohorts, renters, disabled claimants, caregivers, migrants, municipalities, or future taxpayers?
20H_generational_intergovernmental_incid.finding: Borrowers, parents, and future taxpayers can absorb repair differently.

public_balance_sheet_register.exposure_name: Federal student-loan portfolio, repayment/relief design, and collection-hardship public-credit surface
public_balance_sheet_register.legal_authority: Higher Education Act, Direct Loan/FFEL/Perkins authorities, income-driven repayment and forgiveness rules, federal credit-program accounting, Treasury/FSA collection powers
public_balance_sheet_register.claimant_perimeter: Borrowers, families, taxpayers, schools, servicers, employers, Treasury, future students, credential-dependent workers, and household creditors
public_balance_sheet_register.maximum_exposure: Outstanding federal student-loan principal and interest plus administrative, forgiveness, delinquency/default, collection, and policy-change exposure.
public_balance_sheet_register.expected_loss: Credit-program subsidy or gain is method-sensitive; social loss appears through collection hardship, delayed household formation, low-value credentials, and fiscal repair burden.
public_balance_sheet_register.stress_scenario: Repayment-rule volatility, labor-market stress, servicer/administrative backlog, or relief reversal shifts costs to borrowers through delinquency/default, offsets, negative amortization, or foregone fresh start.
public_balance_sheet_register.funding_source: Federal lending, borrower repayments, interest, taxpayers, schools/program accountability, collection recoveries, and future appropriations or credit reestimates.
public_balance_sheet_register.loss_sharing: Loss sharing must include institutions/programs, servicers, taxpayers, high-income borrowers where appropriate, and public credit pricing; hardship borrowers should not be residual claimants after tuition capture.
public_balance_sheet_register.public_upside_recovery: Program accountability, institutional risk sharing, borrower-defense recovery, servicer penalties, low-value program ineligibility, progressive repayment, and fresh-start protections.
public_balance_sheet_register.ordinary_claimant_protection: Protect low-income borrowers, non-completers, disabled borrowers, older borrowers, family caregivers, and hardship cases before collection maximization or school/intermediary protection.
public_balance_sheet_register.sunset_or_review: Quarterly with FSA Data Center portfolio updates and immediately after major repayment, forgiveness, collection, or court/rulemaking changes.

seniority_waterfall.stress_status: Must be senior against punitive collection where public credit financed low-value or interrupted education.
seniority_waterfall.notes: Can collect, forgive, or absorb subsidy changes.

seniority_waterfall.stress_status: Claim security depends on administrable repayment, accurate servicing, and durable forgiveness rules.
seniority_waterfall.notes: Often receive funds upfront without symmetric downside.

seniority_waterfall.stress_status: Should share losses and accountability before hardship borrowers absorb them.
seniority_waterfall.notes: Default and collection can impair housing, family, work, and retirement.

seniority_waterfall.stress_status: Cannot be hidden residual claimants for tuition capture and policy churn.
seniority_waterfall.notes: Policy redesign can shift cost to future cohorts or reduce access.

validation_notes: rev0328 promotes this scoreboard to active: FSA portfolio-data currentness, Treasury credit-program notes, CBO credit-cost methods, and student-loan policy volatility make borrower-incidence and collection-hardship scoring urgent.
